data.body: Operator chose option (1): remove the ACL evidence step and its mechanism-ok marker, then close. Pushed as Gerrit 3475 (patch set 1, b9bae48b12e, base 717c50f8b33), which only deletes the step and its comment block from .github/workflows/test.yml. The marker was admitted, not baselined, so check_mechanism_delta --update-stale leaves the baseline unchanged (stale=0). LLM-Review +1. Verified -1 (run 44732620097): the only failure on py3.11, py3.12 and py3.13 is tests/unit/test_reclaim_resign.py::test_resign_makes_enforced_verify_pass_with_era_keys, the main regression tracked by gloomful-genial-pronghorn. The 273 workflow-structure and mechanism tests pass locally, and so does make lint. Next: once gloomful-genial-pronghorn lands, rebase 3475 onto the fixed main, wait for both votes, submit, then close this ticket as env_integration (sweep evidence: run 44606030731).
